title: The Church’s One Foundation
description: The Church’s One Foundation in Tonic Solfa to AURELIA, doh is D: the solfa with the words, staff notation, five verses and a piano.
about: Samuel John Stone, an English curate, wrote this hymn in 1866 as one of a set on the articles of the Apostles' Creed; this one is on 'the holy catholic Church'. The tune AURELIA was written by Samuel Sebastian Wesley, grandson of Charles Wesley, and first printed in 1864.
underlay: The Church-’s one foun-da-tion Is Je-sus Christ her Lord; She is His new cre-a-tion By wa-ter and the Word: From heav’n He came and sought her To be His ho-ly bride; With His own blood He bought her, And for her life He died.

lines: From heaven He came and sought her
With His own blood He bought her,
And for her life He died.
Yet one o’er all the earth,
One Lord, one faith, one birth;
And to one hope she presses,
Yet saints their watch are keeping,
And soon the night of weeping
Shall be the morn of song.
Shall be the Church at rest.
Yet she on earth hath union
With God the Three in One,
With those whose rest is won:
Lord, give us grace that we,
Like them, the meek and lowly,
On high may dwell with Thee.
